hindi: बुद्धिमान् पुरुष धन की हानि, मन का संताप और घर में दुराचरण, ठगी और अपमान प्रकट न करे।
english: A man of understanding should not disclose loss of wealth, distress of mind and misdeeds in the house, cheating and insult.
notes: Objects of prakāśayet: five items; ca occurs three times (after duścaritāni, after vañcanam, after apamānam). matimān = man of understanding (mati-mat).

words.gloss: one who has given up modesty

hindi: धन-धान्य के लेन-देन में, विद्या के संग्रह में तथा भोजन और व्यवहार में जिसने लज्जा त्याग दी है, वह सुखी हो सकता है।
english: One who has given up modesty in transactions of wealth and grain, likewise in acquiring learning, and in eating and in dealings, would be happy.
notes: prayoga here taken as dealing, transaction (lending, use). bhavet is optative: would be, may be.
lines_deva: आहारे व्यवहारे च त्यक्तलज्जः सुखी भवेत्
lines_iast: āhāre vyavahāre ca tyaktalajjaḥ sukhī bhavet

hindi: संतोष के अमृत से तृप्त लोगों का जो सुख और शान्ति ही है, और वह इधर और उधर दौड़ने वाले धन के लोभियों का नहीं है।
english: The happiness and indeed the peace of those satisfied with the nectar of contentment, and that is not of the wealth-greedy who run hither and thither.
notes: santoṣāmṛta read as nectar of contentment (genitive tat-puruṣa); itaścetaśca = itaḥ ca itaḥ ca, the idiom hither and thither. na ca tat: no verb is stated, is not (theirs) is understood.

hindi: तीन में संतोष करना चाहिए: अपनी पत्नी, भोजन और धन में; और तीन में ही संतोष नहीं करना चाहिए: अध्ययन, जप और दान में।
english: Contentment is to be practised in three: in one's own wife, in food, in wealth; and indeed in three it is not to be practised: in study, in recitation and in giving.
notes: dāra is normally plural; here a singular locative dāre is printed. japa = muttered recitation.

hindi: दो ब्राह्मणों के तथा ब्राह्मण और अग्नि के, पति-पत्नी के, स्वामी और सेवक के, हल और बैल के बीच से नहीं जाना चाहिए।
english: One should not go between two brahmins and between a brahmin and a fire, between husband and wife, between master and servant, between a plough and an ox.
notes: antareṇa takes the genitive: between. gantavyam is impersonal: it is not to be gone, one should not go.
lines_deva: अन्तरेण न गन्तव्यं हलस्य वृषभस्य च
lines_iast: antareṇa na gantavyaṃ halasya vṛṣabhasya ca

hindi: पैरों से अग्नि, गुरु और ब्राह्मण का ही स्पर्श न करे; गाय का बिलकुल नहीं, न कुमारी का और न वृद्ध का, वैसे ही न शिशु का।
english: With the feet one should not touch fire, a teacher, and a brahmin indeed; not at all a cow, not a girl and not an old man, not a child likewise.
notes: Verb spṛśet is understood for the second line. Hindi 'ही' renders eva in brāhmaṇam eva; 'बिलकुल' renders eva in naiva.
lines_deva: पादाभ्यां न स्पृशेदग्निं गुरुं ब्राह्मणमेव च
नैव गां न कुमारीं च न वृद्धं न शिशुं तथा
lines_iast: pādābhyāṃ na spṛśedagniṃ guruṃ brāhmaṇameva ca
naiva gāṃ na kumārīṃ ca na vṛddhaṃ na śiśuṃ tathā

hindi: गाड़ी पाँच हाथ से, घोड़ा दस हाथ से, हाथी हजार हाथ से और दुर्जन देश के त्याग से।
english: A cart at five hands, a horse at ten hands, an elephant at a thousand hands, a wicked man by leaving the country.
notes: No verb is stated; a verb of keeping away or avoiding is understood but not translated. hasta = hand, the cubit measure.

words.gloss: by one with a stick in hand
by one with a sword in hand

hindi: हाथी अंकुश मात्र से और घोड़ा हाथ से ताड़ित किया जाता है; सींगवाला हाथ में लाठी रखने वाले से और दुर्जन हाथ में तलवार रखने वाले से ताड़ित होता है।
english: The elephant is struck with a mere goad, the horse with the hand; the horned one with one who has a stick in hand, the wicked man with one who has a sword in hand.
notes: tāḍyate is understood for the second line. Writing hastī aṅkuśa keeps the printed hiatus.

hindi: ब्राह्मण भोजन में, मोर मेघ की गर्जना में, साधु दूसरे की सम्पत्ति में और खल दूसरों की विपत्तियों में प्रसन्न होते हैं।
english: Brahmins are pleased at a meal, peacocks at thunder of clouds, the good at another's prosperity, the base at others' calamities.
notes: khala = base, mean person.

hindi: बलवान् को अनुकूलता से, दुर्जन को प्रतिकूलता से, अपने समान बल वाले शत्रु को विनय से अथवा बल से।
english: The strong man by going with the grain, the wicked man by going against the grain, an enemy equal to oneself in strength by humility or by strength.
notes: No verb is stated; one such as win over or deal with is understood but not translated. anuloma and pratiloma are rendered literally as with and against the grain.

hindi: राजाओं का बल भुजाओं का पराक्रम है; ब्राह्मण ब्रह्म को जानने वाला बलवान है; स्त्रियों का सर्वोत्तम बल रूप, यौवन और माधुर्य है।
english: Valour of arm is the strength of kings; the brahmin, a knower of Brahman, is strong; beauty, youth and sweetness are the unsurpassed strength of women.

text_flags.why: possible: brahmaṇaḥ (genitive of brahman) leaves brahmavidbalī without a subject, while brāhmaṇaḥ gives a nominative to go with balī; suggestion rests on form and sense only

notes: Words and translation follow the possible correction brāhmaṇaḥ. If brahmaṇaḥ is kept it can only be a genitive (of Brahman or the Veda) and the line becomes hard to construe.

hindi: अत्यन्त सीधे नहीं होना चाहिए; जाकर वन-स्थली को देखो; वहाँ सीधे वृक्ष काटे जाते हैं, टेढ़े वृक्ष खड़े रहते हैं।
english: One must not be too straight; having gone, see the forest-land: there the straight are cut, the crooked trees stand.
notes: saralaiḥ bhāvyam is impersonal: it is to be by the straight. sarala also means simple, upright; rendered straight to match the trees. pādapāḥ is the noun in both halves of the contrast.

hindi: जहाँ जल है, वहाँ हंस बसते हैं; वैसे ही वे सूखे को छोड़ देते हैं। मनुष्य को हंस के समान नहीं होना चाहिए: बार-बार छोड़ते हुए वे बार-बार आश्रय लेते हैं।
english: Where there is water, there swans dwell; so indeed they abandon the dry one. A man equal to a swan is not to be: abandoning again, they resort again.
notes: Word break across lines: the visarga of haṃsāḥ is written as s at the start of line b (stathaiva); words are assigned haṃsāḥ to the first token and tathā eva to the second. The subject of the last pāda is plural and understood as the swan-like.

words.gloss: standing in the belly of a tank

hindi: कमाए हुए धन का त्याग ही सचमुच रक्षा है, जैसे तालाब के भीतर ठहरे हुए जलों का निकास।
english: Of acquired wealth, giving away itself is indeed the protection, like the outflow of waters standing in the belly of a tank.
notes: tyāga = giving up, giving away, liberality; rendered giving away. parīvāha = overflow, outlet; the comparison is with the outlet of tank waters. Hindi ही and सचमुच render eva and hi.
lines_deva: उपार्जितानां वित्तानां त्याग एव हि रक्षणम्
lines_iast: upārjitānāṃ vittānāṃ tyāga eva hi rakṣaṇam

hindi: जिसके धन है, उसके मित्र हैं; जिसके धन है, उसके बन्धु हैं; जिसके धन है, वह संसार में पुरुष है; जिसके धन है, वह, और पण्डित।
english: Whose is wealth, his are friends; whose is wealth, his are kinsmen; whose is wealth, he is a man in the world; whose is wealth, he, and a learned man.
notes: pumā~lloke: the printed ~ marks the nasalised sandhi pumān + loke (pumāṃl loke); no error assumed. arthāḥ is plural: wealth, possessions.
lines_deva: यस्यार्थाः स पुमाँल्लोके यस्यार्थाः स च पण्डितः
lines_iast: yasyārthāḥ sa pumā~lloke yasyārthāḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ

words.gloss: in the world of the living

hindi: स्वर्ग में स्थित लोगों के, यहाँ जीवलोक में, देह में चार चिह्न रहते हैं: दान में आसक्ति और मधुर वाणी, देवों की पूजा और ब्राह्मणों को तृप्त करना।
english: Of those established in heaven, here in the world of the living, four marks dwell in the body: devotion to giving, and sweet speech, worship of the gods, and satisfying of brahmins.
notes: svargasthitānām is read as those whose place is heaven, as applied here in the living world; the first line is printed as one pāda of an upajāti stanza. prasaṃga = attachment, devotion.

words.gloss: service of those devoid of family

hindi: अत्यन्त क्रोध और कटु वाणी, दरिद्रता और अपने जनों में वैर, नीचों की संगति, कुलहीनों की सेवा: ये नरक में स्थित लोगों के देह में चिह्न हैं।
english: Extreme anger and harsh speech, poverty and enmity among one's own people, association with the low, service of those devoid of family: marks in the body of those established in hell.
notes: The verse is one list; cihnāni in the last line is the predicate for all items. kulahīna rendered devoid of family.

words.gloss: abode of the lord of beasts

hindi: यदि पशुओं के राजा के घर में जाया जाता है, हाथी के मस्तक का मोती पाया जाता है; और सियार के घर गए हुए को बछड़े की पूँछ और गधे की खाल का काटना मिलते हैं।
english: If the abode of the lord of beasts is gone to, a pearl of an elephant's skull is obtained; and for one gone to a jackal's dwelling a calf's tail and cutting of donkey's hide are got.
notes: gamyate is impersonal passive with mṛgendramandiram as the place gone to (accusative). khaṇḍana = breaking, cutting; rendered literally. The compound is hard to analyse (calf's tail / cutting of donkey's hide). mṛgendra = lord of beasts, the lion.

hindi: विद्या के बिना जीवन कुत्ते की पूँछ के समान व्यर्थ है; वह न गुप्त अंग को ढकने में समर्थ है और न दंश के निवारण में।
english: Life without learning is useless like a dog's tail; it is not capable in covering the private parts and not in warding off bites.
notes: The subject of śaktam is the dog's tail (and by comparison life). daṃśa may be a bite or a biting insect.
lines_deva: शुनः पुच्छमिव व्यर्थं जीवितं विद्यया विना
न गुह्यगोपने शक्तं न च दंशनिवारणे
lines_iast: śunaḥ pucchamiva vyarthaṃ jīvitaṃ vidyayā vinā
na guhyagopane śaktaṃ na ca daṃśanivāraṇe

words.gloss: purity of compassion for all beings

hindi: वाणी की शुद्धि और मन की शुद्धि, इन्द्रियों का निग्रह, सब प्राणियों पर दया की शुद्धि: यह परार्थ चाहने वालों की शुद्धि है।
english: Purity of speech, and purity of mind, restraint of the senses, purity of compassion for all beings: this is the purity of those who seek another's good.
notes: parārthin is ambiguous: seeking another's good, or seeking the highest aim (para as supreme); the first is taken. vācām is a genitive plural form.

hindi: फूल में गन्ध, तिल में तेल, काष्ठ में अग्नि, दूध में घी, ईख में गुड़, वैसे ही देह में विवेक से आत्मा को देखो।
english: Fragrance in a flower, oil in sesame, fire in wood, ghee in milk, jaggery in sugarcane, likewise in the body see the self by discrimination.
notes: paśya is stated once, at the end; whether it also governs the five examples is left open. guḍa = raw sugar (jaggery).
lines_deva: पुष्पे गन्धं तिले तैलं काष्ठेऽग्निं पयसि घृतम्
इक्षौ गुडं तथा देहे पश्यात्मानं विवेकतः
lines_iast: puṣpe gandhaṃ tile tailaṃ kāṣṭhe'gniṃ payasi ghṛtam
ikṣau guḍaṃ tathā dehe paśyātmānaṃ vivekataḥ
